method: Read-only source-master audit. Per-component raw physical-edge/curve-control-point matching at2e-5 endpoint tolerance, plus evaluated physical surface BVH with five samples along every diagram segment at source frame1. Distances are observations, not automatic visual acceptance. Missing groups and outliers remain explicit.
limitations: This checks hidden technical curves in each source master. Separate exported static/information GLBs require their own source-bound import checks.
Centreline diagrams of thin rods naturally lie inside their physical surfaces.
Raw pre-bevel skeleton edges can differ from evaluated surfaces by the authored bevel width.
Surface proximity alone does not prove semantic ownership or recovered legacy geometry.
No threshold is used to declare the entire task complete.
